the Supabase project's Google provider configuration (owner-configured, already verified)

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Load the candidate demo build — zero public canary traffic; the Google entry reaches an identity provider but performs no marketplace write
candidateVerificationJourney.notes: Issue's own Release evidence section as amended by ADR-094: 'complete the replay entry end to end with the network tab showing no /v1/* request, and reach the connect-shop screen from the Google entry.' Transcribed verbatim; no additional surfaces inferred. The Google consent screen is External + Testing, so only listed test users complete sign-in — that is configuration, not a defect.

journeys.name: replay-entry-issues-no-authenticated-request
assertions: the Dùng thử Demo entry renders and is reachable by keyboard
taking the replay entry issues no request to any /v1/* route for the whole journey
no Supabase session is created; no auth token is stored
the surface is labelled honestly as a demonstration

journeys.name: google-entry-reaches-connect-shop
assertions: the Đăng nhập với Google entry redirects to the Supabase authorize endpoint
a completed sign-in returns to the app and lands on the Kết nối TikTok Shop screen
the connect-shop screen states its real state — no control implies a working merchant exchange
sign-in failure renders a real error, never a silent fall-through to fixture content

staticAssetChecks.notes: Issue text: 'auth callback routes must exist in the built artifact.' Assert the callback route file is present in the built output, not only in source — the failure mode is a next-start 500 on a missing chunk after a sign-in round trip.

migrationCompatibility.notes: Issue text: 'No migration.' Client-side entry points and auth routing in apps/demo only.

rollbackAssertion.notes: Issue text: 'assert a rollback does not leave a live sign-in button pointing at a route that no longer exists.' A rollback must remove the entry and its route together, never one without the other.

doNotInfer: release evidence fields beyond what the issue's Release evidence (ADR-035) section states
an anonymous Supabase session, a demo-tenant scoping rule, or an X-Shop-Id header on the replay path — ADR-094 decision 1 withdrew all three
identity linking between the replay entry and a Google identity — #1353 is dissolved
wiring live TikTok merchant OAuth — the connect-shop screen is built, the exchange is a flagged follow-up
provisioning a public.users row on first sign-in — that is backend domain and its own slice; surface the 401 honestly instead of working around it
TikTok Login Kit as an identity provider
